_comment: Ranking configurations for `python -m librarian relevance`. Each is a set of overrides onto CatalogueConfig, so a method is data rather than a code edit - the arrangement `JayLZhou - GraphRAG` uses to make ten published methods comparable. A configuration that lost is kept rather than deleted: a rejected option nobody can re-run is folklore, not a finding.

configurations.name: current
configurations.note: what ships

configurations.name: ceiling-0.34
configurations.note: the ceiling before 2026-09-04, when `file`, `files`, `read` and `test` were being discarded

configurations.name: ceiling-0.42
configurations.note: lower edge of the plateau

configurations.name: ceiling-0.62
configurations.note: past the plateau, where useful@5 falls away

configurations.name: no-elimination
configurations.note: keep every term regardless of how common it is

configurations.name: coverage-bm25
configurations.note: order covered notes by the score FTS5 already computed rather than by term count, so `malformed` outweighs `service` instead of tying with it

configurations.name: coverage-idf
configurations.note: the naive weighting measured and rejected on 2026-09-04; kept selectable so the rejection stays reproducible

configurations.name: coverage-3-terms
configurations.note: require three matched terms to count as covered, not two

configurations.name: coverage-halved
configurations.note: keep coverage as a signal but halve its say in the fusion

configurations.name: coverage-off
configurations.note: name and text rankings only - does the coverage stage earn its place at all?

configurations.name: bm25-and-3-terms
configurations.note: the two most promising single changes together

configurations.name: scope-all
configurations.note: measure document frequency over every note, as it was before 2026-09-04 - 160 short glossary and pattern notes diluting the statistic

configurations.name: scope-all-0.34
configurations.note: the full pre-2026-09-04 behaviour, both knobs together

configurations.name: answerable-0.34
configurations.note: correct denominator, old ceiling

configurations.name: answerable-0.60
configurations.note: correct denominator, looser ceiling

configurations.name: answerable-0.70
configurations.note: correct denominator, looser still

configurations.name: segmented
configurations.note: drop terms the query marks as out of scope; everything else as shipped

configurations.name: segmented-terms
configurations.note: segmentation plus the older coverage ordering, to check the two do not interact

configurations.name: segment-weighted
configurations.note: weight matched terms by ask/context/excluded rather than deleting excluded ones

configurations.name: segment-weighted+drop
configurations.note: weighting and deletion together, to see whether they compound or cancel

configurations.name: components-on
configurations.note: also return addresses inside a source, appended after the notes and capped at three

configurations.name: no-vectors
configurations.note: lexical only - the behaviour before embeddings existed

configurations.name: vectors-heavy
configurations.note: double the vector ranking's weight in the fusion
